style: Hard-surface science-fiction spacecraft and space-station materials, realistic industrial aerospace look, used but well kept.

cells.name: hull
cells.prompt: Spaceship outer hull: light grey painted metal armor panels of many different rectangular sizes, recessed panel seams, rows of flush rivets, a few small square access hatches and vent slots, faint soot streaks and light weathering.

cells.name: wall
cells.prompt: Space-station corridor wall seen straight-on: light grey modular wall panels, a band of vent slats near the top, a horizontal pipe band, big smooth bolted panels in the middle, darker kick plates along the bottom edge with a thin worn yellow strip.

cells.name: plate
cells.prompt: Steel diamond-plate (checker plate) floor made of 2x2 large square plates with bolted corners, raised diamond pattern, scuffs, boot marks and grime in the corners.

cells.name: grate
cells.prompt: Industrial galvanized steel bar grating floor (catwalk grate) seen from above: parallel flat bars with cross rods, deep dark void between the bars.

cells.name: hex
cells.prompt: Science-fiction floor of hexagonal metal tiles: slightly raised satin grey hex plates with bevelled edges and dark gaps, a few tiles with small inset center plates.

cells.name: rib
cells.prompt: Ribbed steel sheet with evenly spaced vertical rounded ribs and two horizontal reinforcing bands, light scratches and grime.

cells.name: ceil
cells.prompt: Science-fiction ceiling: grid of square dark grey metal ceiling panels with deep seams, some panels with ventilation slats, some with a recessed light strip (unlit).

cells.name: bulk
cells.prompt: Heavy riveted steel bulkhead: large staggered rectangular steel plates with dense rows of round rivets along every edge, rust streaks running down, grime and oil stains.

cells.name: smooth
cells.prompt: Smooth white composite wall panels of a clean futuristic interior: large square panels with thin precise seams, a few small inset ventilation grilles, matte finish.
